recognize_zh: 高倍脾臟 H&E 中，紅髓被中到大型淋巴樣細胞浸潤，核卵圓、染色質泡狀、多有小而清楚的核仁，細胞質中量淡嗜雙性，夾雜紅血球與含鐵血黃素；細胞比典型脾臟邊緣區淋巴瘤偏大，需排除大細胞轉化。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of medium to large lymphoid cells with oval to round vesicular nuclei
Small but distinct nucleoli in many cells, with occasional binucleate or irregular nuclei
Moderate amounts of pale amphophilic cytoplasm with fairly distinct cell borders
Cells permeate red pulp with interspersed red blood cells and elongated sinus-lining/stromal cells
Scattered brown hemosiderin granules; occasional small lymphocytes and a few mitotic-appearing figures
describe_en: High-power section of spleen shows red pulp diffusely infiltrated by medium to large lymphoid cells with oval vesicular nuclei, small distinct nucleoli and moderate pale amphophilic cytoplasm, admixed with red blood cells, sinus-lining cells and scattered hemosiderin. The cells in this field are larger than the typical small-to-medium marginal zone cells of splenic marginal zone lymphoma. No overt necrosis is seen. The appearance is compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma involving red pulp, but the proportion of large cells raises the possibility of large-cell transformation, which should be evaluated with Ki-67 and review of sheets of large cells across the specimen.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (including transformation of SMZL)
ddx.vs: Defined by confluent sheets of large cells with high Ki-67, whereas SMZL is dominated by small to medium cells with only scattered large cells.
Cells have bland bean-shaped nuclei without nucleoli and abundant clear cytoplasm, with CD103, CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positivity.

ddx.dx: Pleomorphic or blastoid mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Shows cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity with CD5 expression and CCND1 rearrangement.
Medium-sized cells fill red pulp sinusoids with a CD3+ CD5- gamma-delta T-cell phenotype and isochromosome 7q.
